tickets.subject: Sharing dashboards externally with auditors
tickets.body: Our external auditors will need read-only access to two of our dashboards for the upcoming annual audit. Is there a way to generate a time-limited external share link, or would we need to create guest accounts for them? We'd want access to expire automatically once the audit period ends in September. Could you talk us through the options? Marit

tickets.subject: API returning stale data intermittently
tickets.body: We're seeing the API occasionally return data that's a day or two out of date, even though the underlying dashboard shows current figures. Reproduced twice this week on the same endpoint (revenue-by-region). Cache issue on your end, perhaps? It's making our downstream automation unreliable since we can't tell which pulls are fresh without cross-checking manually. Would appreciate a look when you get a chance. Tuomas

tickets.subject: Export job stuck in queue for over a day
tickets.body: One of our scheduled exports has been sitting in 'processing' for more than 24 hours now rather than completing or failing outright, which is unusual — normally it's one or the other. This delayed a report we needed for a board meeting yesterday, so we ended up pulling the numbers together manually instead. We've started looking more closely at alternatives, Storsund BI among them, partly prompted by moments like this one. Could you look into what's stuck? Marit

tickets.subject: Dashboard sharing links expiring early
tickets.body: The external share links we set up for our auditors back in July stopped working weeks before the expiry date we'd configured. We've since renewed them manually as a stopgap. It's a similar theme to a few other things we've flagged this year — small inconsistencies rather than outright breakage — and it's part of why Storsund BI keeps coming up in our internal conversations about next year's tooling. Not asking for anything beyond understanding why the expiry didn't hold. Tuomas

tickets.subject: Report builder — closing out a few threads
tickets.body: Wanted to flag one more thing before quarter close — a saved report template lost its custom column order after the last platform update, similar in spirit to the dashboard and export issues we've raised since last summer. We've rebuilt the template manually, so there's no urgency here. As mentioned before, we're continuing to look at Storsund BI as part of our renewal planning, largely because these small resets have added up to a fair amount of manual tidying over the past year. Marit

tickets.subject: Connector setup for new Snowflake warehouse
tickets.body: We've migrated to a new Snowflake instance and need to repoint our existing data connector to it. Could you send over the steps for updating the connection string and re-authenticating, or would this need to be done on your side? Ideally we'd want to do this over a weekend to minimise disruption to daytime reporting. Let me know what you need from us. Tero

tickets.subject: Connector still pointing at old warehouse intermittently
tickets.body: Since the migration ten days ago, the connector mostly works fine against the new Snowflake instance, but two syncs since then have quietly pulled from the old (now read-only) warehouse instead, meaning we got stale numbers without any error being thrown. That's the concerning part — it fails silently rather than flagging. Could you check whether the old connection details are still cached somewhere? Tero

tickets.subject: Dashboard numbers off after the connector mix-up
tickets.body: Downstream of the connector issue from before Christmas, we found two dashboards that had been quietly showing numbers from the old warehouse for about a week before anyone noticed, since nothing errored. We've had to manually reconcile those figures in Excel and re-send a corrected report to two department heads, which was an uncomfortable conversation to have. I'd like some assurance this silent-failure mode is being addressed properly, not just the immediate connector fix. Tero

tickets.subject: API silently returning cached results
tickets.body: Similar shape of problem to the connector issue in December/January — we're now seeing the API occasionally return cached results without any header or flag indicating staleness, discovered when a scheduled job we run against it produced numbers that didn't match a parallel Excel-based check we'd started doing as a precaution since then. Could the API responses include some kind of last-updated timestamp so we can detect this ourselves going forward? Tero

tickets.subject: Report builder — scheduled report sent with old template
tickets.body: This month's automated report builder send went out using what looks like a cached version of the template from two revisions ago, missing a column we'd added in February. We caught it before it reached the board but it's the same silent-staleness pattern we've now seen across connectors, API and report builder since December. We've started keeping a manual pre-send checklist to catch this ourselves. Tero

tickets.subject: Same stale-template issue, two weeks later
tickets.body: Happened again — same report, same stale-template symptom as the one from a couple of weeks ago. Our pre-send checklist caught it again before distribution, so no harm done, but I'll note we're now running that check on every scheduled send as standard practice rather than treating it as a one-off. Not asking for immediate escalation, just keeping the record straight given the pattern since December. Tero

tickets.subject: Connector to our accounting system not syncing
tickets.body: Our connector to Procountor stopped syncing three days ago, no error message on our end. Could you check what's happening?

tickets.subject: Dashboard showing stale data
tickets.body: One of our dashboards is still showing last week's figures even though the underlying connector looks fine now. Can you take a look?

tickets.subject: Setting up threshold alert
tickets.body: We'd like to set up an alert for when weekly sales drop below a set threshold. Is there a guide for this, or can someone help us configure it?

tickets.subject: Report builder — merging two templates
tickets.body: Is there a way to merge two existing report templates into one, or do we need to rebuild from scratch? Trying to avoid duplicating work.

tickets.subject: Scheduled export not arriving
tickets.body: Our weekly scheduled export to email didn't come through this Monday. Can you check the schedule is still active on our account?

tickets.subject: Help with conditional formatting in report builder
tickets.body: We're trying to set up conditional formatting to flag variances over 10% in a report — could you point us to the right settings? Really pleased with how flexible the builder has been so far.

tickets.subject: Adding seats before year end
tickets.body: We need three more seats added before year-end close. Also, for context, we evaluated Dashlume earlier in the year but stuck with Kataja because the reporting depth won out — good to confirm that decision was right.

tickets.subject: Feature request: variance column in default templates
tickets.body: Would it be possible to add a built-in variance-to-budget column option in the standard report templates? We rebuild this manually every month at the moment.

tickets.subject: Alert digest instead of individual emails
tickets.body: Could Alerts support a daily digest option rather than one email per trigger? We're getting quite a few separate emails now that we've added more thresholds.

tickets.subject: Nice work on the new dashboard layout options
tickets.body: The new grid layout options in Dashboards have made our exec view much cleaner. One question — is there a way to lock the layout so others on the team don't accidentally rearrange it?

tickets.subject: Report builder — page break control
tickets.body: Is there a way to force a page break in a specific place when exporting a report to PDF? Currently it splits mid-table.

tickets.subject: Alert threshold reset after edit
tickets.body: Every time we edit an existing alert's recipients, the threshold value resets to default. Having to re-enter it each time, which is a bit error-prone.

tickets.subject: Date range filter behaving oddly in monthly report
tickets.body: The date range filter on our monthly P&L report seems to shift by one day when the month starts on a weekend. January and April were both off by a day. Is this a timezone setting or something in how the filter calculates month boundaries?

tickets.subject: Report template duplication not copying all settings
tickets.body: When I duplicate a report template, the column formatting and conditional highlighting rules don't carry over. I have to redo them manually each time. Is this expected behavior or a bug? We use templates quite a bit so it's adding unnecessary overhead.

tickets.subject: PostgreSQL connector — authentication error after DB update
tickets.body: Our PostgreSQL connector started returning an authentication error after the database was updated to version 15. Credentials haven't changed. Is there a known compatibility issue or a connector update needed?

tickets.subject: Connector sync lag — data arriving 3–4 hours late
tickets.body: Since last week our main data connector has been syncing 3 to 4 hours behind schedule. We have it set to sync every hour but it's clearly not keeping up. Nothing changed on our infrastructure side. This is affecting morning reporting for the finance team.

tickets.subject: API rate limit errors — no warning in docs about threshold
tickets.body: We're hitting 429 errors on the reporting API during our batch export window. The documentation doesn't clearly state what the rate limit is for Professional plan. We shouldn't be hitting limits at the volume we're running — can someone clarify the actual thresholds and whether there's a way to request a higher limit? This is the second time we've had to chase down something that should be documented upfront.

tickets.subject: Batch export missing rows — silent failure
tickets.body: Batch export completes clean but output's missing the last rows. Started two weeks ago. Thought August's fix covered this.

tickets.subject: Calculated field rounding inconsistency
tickets.body: A calculated field we use for margin percentages rounds differently depending on whether you're viewing it in the report builder vs. in a scheduled export. In-app shows two decimal places, export shows none. This causes confusion when the finance team compares printed reports to the dashboard. Please fix this — it's not a minor cosmetic issue when the numbers look different.

tickets.subject: Alert emails stopped completely
tickets.body: All alert emails stopped sending as of December 5th. I can see the alerts are triggering in the system (the status shows 'fired') but nothing is arriving in any inbox. Checked spam folders. We rely on these for daily financial threshold monitoring and right now we're effectively blind. This needs urgent attention.

tickets.subject: Export job timing out on large datasets
tickets.body: Every export job over roughly 50,000 rows is timing out. This started in December and has not been resolved despite me raising the alert email issue at the same time. I now have two open problems affecting daily operations and no resolution on either. The export timeout is completely blocking our month-end reporting. I need a response on both of these, not just an acknowledgment.

tickets.subject: Salesforce connector broken after Kataja update
tickets.body: The Salesforce connector stopped working after whatever update you pushed last week. Getting 'invalid_grant' errors. Our Salesforce credentials and OAuth setup are unchanged. This is the third connector issue we've had in six months. Please fix it and let me know what changed.

tickets.subject: Connector sync dropping rows on large tables
tickets.body: The Salesforce connector is syncing again but we're seeing row count discrepancies — about 2–3% of records are missing after each sync on our largest table. This is not acceptable for financial data. I had a similar issue flagged months ago and was told it was resolved. It clearly wasn't. I need this escalated.

tickets.subject: Currency formatting in report builder
tickets.body: Our reports default to EUR formatting even for the NOK subsidiary figures — is there a way to set currency per data source?

tickets.subject: Adding a new user to dashboard group
tickets.body: Could you add our new controller to the finance dashboard group? Same access as the rest of the team, thanks.

tickets.subject: Alert not sending to whole distribution list
tickets.body: We set up an alert for three recipients but only one is receiving it. Can you check the distribution list settings on our account?

tickets.subject: New connector for logistics data
tickets.body: We'd like to connect our logistics tracking system as a new data source. Do you support a direct connector, or would this need the API?

tickets.subject: Alert firing too frequently
tickets.body: One of our alerts is triggering multiple times a day for the same event. Could you help us adjust the frequency settings?

tickets.subject: Report builder template locked from editing
tickets.body: One of our shared templates seems locked — none of the team can edit it, though we haven't changed any permissions. Can you check on your side?

tickets.subject: Report builder — duplicate template option
tickets.body: Is there a quick way to duplicate an existing report template rather than building a new one from scratch each time?

tickets.subject: Report builder crashing on save
tickets.body: Since the December update, saving a report with more than three charts sometimes fails silently — no error, but the changes aren't kept. Happened twice this week.

tickets.subject: Export file naming
tickets.body: Could exported files include the report name in the filename automatically? Right now everything downloads as export.csv which gets confusing.

tickets.subject: Dashboard widget resizing oddly
tickets.body: One of our chart widgets keeps resizing itself smaller every time the dashboard reloads. Not a big deal but a bit annoying to keep fixing.

tickets.subject: Dashboard load time
tickets.body: Our main dashboard has gotten noticeably slower to load over the past couple of weeks — anything changed on your end, or is it something with our data volume?

tickets.subject: Removing a departed user

tickets.subject: Alert recipients not updating
tickets.body: We updated the recipient list on one of our alerts but the old email is still getting notifications too. Can you check the config?

tickets.subject: Seat count check before renewal
tickets.body: Ahead of our renewal, could you confirm our current active seat count? Want to true it up before the quote goes out.

tickets.subject: Custom branding on regional dashboards
tickets.body: As part of our Enterprise rollout to the Nordic regional offices, we'd like to apply our updated corporate branding (logo, colour palette) to the shared dashboard templates. Could you confirm the process for updating this at the workspace level, and whether it needs to be applied per-dashboard or can be set centrally? We'd like this in place ahead of our September regional review. Erik

tickets.subject: Scheduled export distribution list not updating
tickets.body: We updated the distribution list for our weekly regional export last month to add two new country leads, but the export is still only going to the original recipients. I've re-saved the schedule twice since noticing this. Could someone check on your end whether the update is actually persisting, since it doesn't appear to be reflected in what's going out? Erik

tickets.subject: Report builder performance with large regional datasets
tickets.body: Our regional consolidation report, which pulls from all six country instances, has become noticeably slow to render in the report builder over the past couple of months — often ten to fifteen seconds per page. A couple of the regional finance leads have gone back to compiling their sections in Excel and sending them to me to stitch together manually, which rather defeats the purpose of having this centralised. Could performance at this scale be looked at? Erik

tickets.subject: Connector reliability across regional instances
tickets.body: Following on from the distribution list issue in December and the report builder slowness in January, we're now seeing intermittent connector sync failures across two of our six regional instances, most recently Sweden and Denmark this week. Each time it's been resolved quickly enough, but the recurrence across different parts of the platform this year has led our regional leads to keep their own local exports as a fallback, so operationally we're covered either way. Wanted this on record for our upcoming renewal conversation. Erik

tickets.subject: API token expiring unexpectedly
tickets.body: Our API token seems to be expiring earlier than the documented duration. We've had to regenerate it twice this month. Can you check the expiry settings on our account?

tickets.subject: Export encoding issue with special characters
tickets.body: CSV exports are mangling Nordic characters (ä, ö) in company names. Could this be set to UTF-8 by default?

tickets.body: We'd like to add a rolling 12-month trend view to our main finance dashboard, currently it only shows calendar year to date. Is this something we can configure ourselves via the widget settings, or does it need a custom calculation set up on your end? An example of the kind of chart we're after is attached. Would appreciate guidance either way. Ingrid

tickets.subject: Seat count discrepancy on invoice
tickets.body: Our latest invoice shows eight active seats, but we count only six people currently using the platform — two colleagues left in November and December respectively and I understood their seats were removed at the time. Could you check the account and confirm the current active count, and whether we're due a credit for the two unused seats since November? Ingrid

tickets.subject: API errors since seat count was corrected
tickets.body: Since the seat discrepancy was sorted out in February, we've had two occasions where our API integration returned authentication errors overnight, requiring a manual token refresh the next morning to get things running again. It's a new issue as far as I can tell, unrelated to the seats matter, but it's the second admin-adjacent hiccup this year, and it's exactly the kind of thing that's come up as we've started comparing notes with Storsund BI ahead of renewal discussions. Ingrid

tickets.subject: Threshold alerts not firing
tickets.body: We configured a threshold alert back in the spring to notify us if daily revenue drops below a set level, and it hasn't fired even on a day we know it should have (July's month-end figures). Could you check whether the alert configuration is still active? We're relying on it more now that a couple of other things have made us slightly less trusting of the platform generally, so it would help to have this one working properly, particularly with Storsund BI's alerting being one of the things under comparison. Ingrid

tickets.subject: Dashboard and alerts — pattern this year
tickets.body: Adding the main finance dashboard to the list — it's been showing last-refreshed timestamps that don't match when data actually updated, on and off since the alerts issue in August. We've adapted by cross-checking the refresh time against a manual timestamp we keep before trusting the numbers for anything external-facing. Given the run of small things this year — seats, API auth, alerts, and now this — Storsund BI has moved from a background comparison to something we're actively evaluating properly for next year. Ingrid

tickets.subject: One more for the record — report builder formatting
tickets.body: A saved report lost its number formatting (currency symbols, decimal places) after last week's update, reverting to plain numbers, which meant an external stakeholder received a report that looked unfinished. We caught it and resent a corrected version, so there's no ongoing impact, but I wanted to note it alongside everything else logged this year rather than raise it as a fresh, unconnected issue. No need to treat this one urgently on your end. Ingrid

tickets.subject: Connector sync frequency
tickets.body: Can we increase our data connector sync frequency from daily to every six hours? Our reporting cycle needs fresher numbers.

tickets.subject: Adding a read-only viewer role

tickets.subject: Alert not respecting business hours

tickets.subject: Second alert with the same overnight issue
tickets.body: Similar to the alert scheduling issue from earlier in the year — a newer alert we set up is also firing outside business hours. Could you check this one too?

tickets.subject: Grouping options in report builder
tickets.body: Is there a way to group report builder tables by two levels simultaneously (e.g. region, then department within region) rather than just one? Currently I can only apply a single grouping level, which means I'm exporting and reworking the structure manually afterwards. If this exists already I may simply be missing the setting. Maja

tickets.subject: API integration failing after credential rotation
tickets.body: We rotated our API credentials as part of our routine security review, and the integration has been failing to authenticate since, despite following the documented steps for updating the key on our end. This has held up a piece of automated reporting we rely on for a partner update due this week. We are also, separately, looking at Dashlume as part of a broader vendor review this year, and ease of credential management is one of the criteria on the list. Could someone help urgently? Maja

Given the accumulation of small admin-side issues this year, this is exactly the kind of thing coming up in our Dashlume comparison, for what it's worth. Maja

tickets.body: We configured a webhook alert to notify our Slack channel but nothing is coming through. Direct email alerts work fine, so it seems specific to the webhook.

tickets.subject: Large export keeps timing out — third time raising this
tickets.body: Export timeouts on large datasets are still happening. I've mentioned this informally before and now I'm logging it formally. I need someone to actually look at our account and tell me what's going on.

tickets.subject: API completely down — no response
tickets.body: The Kataja API is returning no response at all — not even an error code, just a connection timeout. All endpoints. This is not a latency issue, it's a complete outage for our account. We need this fixed immediately. Previous slow performance issues were never properly resolved and now we've hit a wall.

tickets.subject: Dashboards showing stale data after API issues

tickets.subject: Export reliability — any point in trying again?
tickets.body: Running another large export. I'll log it here when it times out. Honestly at this point I'm just documenting these for our internal records. This has been an issue since at least August and the fix we were offered didn't hold.

tickets.subject: Export failing on large monthly report

tickets.subject: Report builder unusable for two weeks now
tickets.body: This is now the third module to break since May — exports, connectors, and now report builder won't render our quarterly template at all. Fifteen days to fix is far too long when we're trying to close a quarter.

tickets.subject: API errors again
tickets.body: API calls failing again this morning. Given everything since May, I'd like some visibility into what's actually causing these repeated breakages.

tickets.subject: Escalating — API down, no update in days
tickets.body: The API has been down since Monday with no meaningful update from support. After the pattern we saw last year, I need someone senior to own this and give us a real timeline, not another generic response.
